title: Goodness and Mer Sea Vacation Rental
meta_description: Goodness and Mer-Sea is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 10)- Parking for 2 Cars (Garage Access Available) - 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 6-Seater Electric Cart Included with Rentals- Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Park District- 5 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Camp WaterColor- 2 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access- 4 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to "Goodness and Mer-Sea" at 446 Western Lake Drive—a coastal escape in WaterColor’s Park District where charm meets elegance. This 4-bedroom retreat with designer furnishings and high-end appliances, features expansive porches and an inviting open floor plan perfect for gathering with family and friends. Step inside, where a cozy living room with a gas fireplace flows seamlessly into a chef’s kitchen and a dining area that seats eight. Additional seating awaits at the kitchen bar and on the screened patio off the dining room, perfect for relaxed breakfasts or evening conversations. The main floor also offers a serene master suite with a king bed and ensuite bath, along with a convenient laundry room and half bath. Upstairs, two additional king bedrooms with private bathrooms open onto a spacious screened porch, offering tranquil views of WaterColor’s natural beauty. Between the two is a charming bunk room with twin beds, perfect for kids. The second floor also boasts a cozy den with a sleeper sofa and kitchenette, creating a private haven for kids or teens. But what truly sets "Goodness and Mer-Sea" apart is its unbeatable location. Just a quick two-minute bike ride takes you to the WaterColor Beach Club, shops, and restaurants. With its prime spot and thoughtful touches, this home is perfect for creating memories with loved ones. Let Sanders Beach Rentals help you plan a truly unforgettable stay.
